name: extract_booking_details
description: Capture `{{prospect_timezone}}` (if the prospect corrects it) and `{{booking_confirmed}}` = true — but ONLY after `create_livecall_booking` returns a successful booking. This is the gate that wraps up the call.

variables.name: prospect_timezone
variables.description: Prospect's timezone. Update ONLY if they correct it during booking. Conversion table — no guessing: Eastern/EST/EDT→America/New_York · Central/CST/CDT→America/Chicago · Mountain/MST/MDT→America/Denver · Pacific/PST/PDT→America/Los_Angeles. Speak friendly names aloud, store these exact values.

variables.name: booking_confirmed
variables.description: Set to TRUE only after create_livecall_booking returns a successful booking. Gates the move to the wrap-up.

variables.name: selected_time
variables.description: The chosen slot's `time` value (bare local time in the prospect's zone), copied verbatim from the slot the prospect confirms — set it right after they confirm, before calling create_livecall_booking.

name: query_livecall_slots
description: Checks live-call availability and returns discrete slots ({day, time} — `time` is local in the requested timezone). Pass `slot_target_date` as YYYY-MM-DD for the day the prospect wants — convert 'tomorrow'/'next Monday' to the real date first; omit it only when they want the earliest possible. ALWAYS pass `timezone` = {{prospect_timezone}} so the returned `time` values are already in the prospect's zone — never convert or recompute them yourself. Every response is readable JSON year-200 style: on {"ok": false} read `error` and `message` and follow the message. On success offer the FIRST 1-2 slots — the earliest first.

account_id.description: Which calendar account to use. Fixed per agent — do not change.

slot_target_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the day the prospect wants a slot for. If they say 'next Monday'/'tomorrow'/'this week', convert to the actual date before passing. Omit only for 'as soon as possible'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone to return slot `time` values in — always pass {{prospect_timezone}}.

name: create_livecall_booking
description: Creates the live call booking on Cal.com. CRITICAL: pass `time` as {{selected_time}} VERBATIM (the chosen slot's `time` value, bare local time in the prospect's zone — never recompute it, never use a UTC `iso`). Send `timezone` as {{prospect_timezone}} in IANA format — it must be the SAME zone the `time` value is in. ALWAYS use email = jaydiallux@gmail.com (system shared attendee) and format phoneNumber to E.164 from {{callback_number}} before calling.

name: check_current_date
description: Returns today's REAL date in the system timezone (America/Mexico_City) as {{today_date}} (YYYY-MM-DD). Call it ONCE at the start of the booking flow — every date you compute (tomorrow, this week, next Monday) must be based on its result, never guessed.

name: booking_completed
description: Set booking_completed to true ONLY after: Only after the booking is confirmed on the calendar. Do not set it early.

variables.name: booking_completed
variables.description: true ONLY after: Only after the booking is confirmed on the calendar.
